noise.rule: N1: Policy._rng = jax.random.key(derive_seed(namespace, case_id, stream, decision_ordinal) % 2**32) before each sample; sample 0 = primary stream in every arm

parity.preaction_check: none (no canonical reset table for the Pi0.5 gym env path); pairs rely on seeded resets, scene determinism and M/R/X attribution

records.observation_stride: declared common contract constant 5; executed k recorded in executed_k

determinism.why: XLA GPU autotuning chose different kernels per server process (actions differed by up to 2e-3 for one request and seed); with autotuning off, three concurrent processes were bitwise identical. Disclosed adaptation of openpi's default XLA configuration.
